title: Workplace design & space planning
summary: Layouts, 3D views, lighting, acoustics and materials, planned around how your teams work.
intro: Good offices start with a plan that fits the way people work. We study your teams, headcount and meeting needs, then develop layouts, 3D views and a palette of materials you can review before anything is built.

points.title: Requirement study
points.text: A detailed study of your teams, headcount, meeting rooms and storage once the site is measured.

points.title: See it before it’s built
points.text: 3D views of the proposed interior, so decisions are made on screen rather than on site.

points.title: Vastu, where wanted
points.text: Our in-house Vastu consultant reviews the layout before it is final.

points.title: Light and sound
points.text: Lighting and acoustic design for focused work and clear meetings.

faqs.question: Will we see the design before work starts?
faqs.answer: Yes. We prepare 3D views of the proposed interior so you can review and sign off the design before anything is built.

metaDescription: Office space planning and workplace design in Mumbai: layouts, 3D views, lighting, acoustics and Vastu review.
